name: jev-universal
description: Jev-inspired development Skill with an experimental Codex output hook and optional TypeSafe MCP adapter

interface.longDescription: A portable development Skill for focused exploration, fewer retries, and right-sized verification, plus an experimental Codex hook that compacts large command output. No TypeSafe login or API is required for the Skill or hook; the API adapter is optional.
interface.defaultPrompt: Apply the Jev-inspired efficient development workflow to this task.
